---
applyTo: "**/*.html"
---

# HTML and public-page conventions

- Preserve the static-site architecture and existing page conventions; inspect shared navigation, headers, footers, and metadata before editing.
- Use semantic landmarks and heading order. Keep links, buttons, and form controls native and keyboard accessible; preserve visible focus states and useful accessible names.
- Verify local asset paths, internal routes, same-page fragments, and canonical URLs. Check the actual tracked asset location rather than assuming a directory.
- Keep Open Graph, Twitter, and JSON-LD values accurate and consistent with visible, owner-authorized content. Never invent reviews, client work, credentials, results, or guarantees.
- Preserve useful content and keep core content available if JavaScript fails. Do not change forms, authentication, portal/dashboard, API routes, or backend behavior during unrelated page work.
